propositions: test_a_write_pushing_to_the_origin_leaves_no_detached_upkeep fails deterministically when run after test_push_callers_best_effort.py due to import-time capture of a monkeypatched lock.canonical_tracker
ensures.py imports lock symbols by value during first lazy import while a monkeypatch is active, permanently binding the test's lambda instead of the real function
the polluted ensures.canonical_tracker causes all later run_ensures calls to canonicalize trackers to the polluter's dead tmpdir instead of the real tracker
the victim test's tracker remains unpinned after init-time ensure sweep, causing git to spawn detached maintenance and fail the upkeep oracle
late-binding lock symbols through the module object via 'from rebar._store import lock as _lock' removes the capture hazard and confines the monkeypatch to its scope

regression test test_ensures_late_binding.py pins the patch-active first-import mechanism by removing ensures from sys.modules, importing under monkeypatch, and asserting the real tracker is read post-patch
